display_name: Tasco Insurance combined health insurance rules (scopes A, B, C; standard and special programmes), with the guarantee-hospital list (Annex 5) and the excluded-facility list as data

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese appears only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py quote from line N of the deposited rendering, in the two lists' data rows, and in short runs checked by tools/vnsrc.py check to occur verbatim in a deposited source. tools/vnsrc.py is this row's backward-compatible extension for three source files (NOTES.md section 7).

source.authority: the insurer's own published rules; no decision number or date in the text
the insurer's published list; undated; changes over time
the insurer's published list; undated; says it is updated regularly on the website

sha256_note: The sha256 values are of the PDFs, as subject.json records them; the .txt renderings are pdftotext -layout output of those PDFs.
entry_point: `the outcome of` in tasco-vn19-ch2-cover.l4 (@export): not payable with the reasons, or payable with the amount in VND
scope: The whole document: Articles 1-17 of the rules, 113 coverage rows, 90 encoded and 23 inert with a reason; the Article 8 benefit table for both programmes; the Article 10.1 waiting-period table and 10.2; all 18 exclusions; deadlines of Articles 12 and 16 as date functions and regulative rules; Article 13's document list. The guarantee-hospital list (160 rows) and the excluded-facility list (38 rows) as data, as retrieved on 2026-10-06, with no effect on cover (the rules never refer to them). The injury and surgery tables the rules cite are not in the document: their percentages are inputs and are declined by name when not supplied. Everything the contract or certificate fixes is an input with no default. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F1: 1.1: over 60 is an Article 2.30 age of 61+; 'from 60' means continuous participation begun at 60 or younger.
forks.F2: 2.30: a birthday on the start date does not count ('liền trước').
forks.F3: 1.2: the excluded conditions are tested at the start of the contract.
forks.F4: 4.1(a): no grace period for an unpaid premium (LAW Art 26.1, 37.2 noted).
forks.F5: 2.27: whether poisoning is an accident or an illness is left to the caller.
forks.F6: 2.18: the date formula only for hospitals that do not record hours.
forks.F7: 2.11: a special disease as the medical records classify it; the list is data, not matched.
forks.F8: 7.3: a contract with one scope has no stated consequence; not a reason for refusing a claim.
forks.F10: 2.12(a): the 3 years run back from the start date.
forks.F11: 2.18: where hours are not recorded, two days by the formula meet the 24-hour test.
forks.F13: 8 III.1: the first 10 days of each stay; the special programme's cap over the stay.
forks.F14: 2.15: a premature birth is other maternity care, with no waiting-period row (declined).
forks.F15: 8, 13.4: the programme and the 20-million test use the sum insured of the claimed scope.
forks.F16: 2.8, 8 II.4, III.4: B capped over the contract, C over the policy year.
forks.F17: 9, 2.21(b), 2.22(b): the 180 days of Article 9 run to the day the death occurred or the disability began; certification no earlier than day 180 for paralysis, assessment and loss of function.
forks.F18: 2.26: the gear and hard-helmet qualifiers read literally.
forks.F19: 3: double insurance reduces only benefits that pay costs.
forks.F21: 4.1(c): each scope's cover ends when its own sum insured is paid; the literal whole-contract reading is kept apart.
forks.F22: 4.1(e): the whole premium for the days left; all refunds pro rata by days.
forks.F23: Calendar days; a year is a calendar year (29 Feb to 28 Feb).
forks.F24: 4.2(a): the refund where a claim has arisen is declined by name.
forks.F25: 4.4: a consequence counts by the day it began; a stay is cut at the end date; a stay counted in hours past the end is declined.
forks.F26: 5(1), (4): the next day or the same day; a full year is a year less a day or more.
forks.F27: 5: an increase or an added scope keeps continuity for the rest and serves its own waiting period; a decrease or a dropped scope breaks continuity.
forks.F28: 10: waiting periods run from the first contract of the unbroken chain, or the latest reinstatement.
forks.F29: Day 0 is the day counted from; an N-day period has run on day N.
forks.F30: 10.1: exactly 100 persons has no column; declined where the columns differ (rows 2, 3, 5, 6).
forks.F31: 10.1 row 2 includes a surgery; 10.2 reaches III.1 and III.2 only.
forks.F32: 10.2(d): the ratio counts from the waiting-period start; complications without curettage keep the table.
forks.F33: 11: an exclusion applies when its circumstance is present in this insured event.
forks.F34: 11.3: the limits as printed, 0.25 and 50, in mg/L of breath and mg/100 ml of blood.
forks.F35: 11.8: 'at the insured's request' means without a medical indication.
forks.F36: 11.17: illness only; its year runs from the start of continuous participation.
forks.F37: 7.2: an accident is never a scope C event.
forks.F38: 2.16, 2.24: a cost ordered by someone who is not a 2.16 doctor is not reimbursed.
forks.F39: 8 III.4: the 60- and 90-day limits are prorated, not rounded.
forks.F40: The two lists have no effect on cover: no clause refers to them.
forks.F42: 12.2: the year runs from the event as written (LAW Art 30.2 runs it from knowledge; not encoded).
forks.F43: 14.2(b): proof that exclusions were explained is not required by the rules (LAW Art 19.2; not encoded).
forks.F44: 16.2: 3 years as written; no period in the aid.
